list.title: Guests
list.contactHidden: Email addresses and phone numbers aren’t shown to your role on this event.
list.empty: No guests yet. Import a spreadsheet, or add guests one at a time.
list.refused: The guest list isn’t available to your role on this event.

fields.newHousehold: A new household of their own
fields.moveHelp: Choosing another household moves them there.
fields.seatsHelp: For them and anyone they may bring, from 1 to 20.
fields.householdSeatsHelp_one: At least {{count}}, for the guest already named, and at most 20.
fields.householdSeatsHelp_other: At least {{count}}, for the guests already named, and at most 20.

errors.seats: Enter a whole number from 1 to 20.
errors.seatsBelowNamed: It can’t have fewer seats than the guests already named in it. Remove or move some first.
errors.householdFull: That household has no free seat left. Give it another seat first, or choose another household.
errors.email: This doesn’t look like an email address.
errors.phone: This doesn’t look like a phone number.
errors.refused: This wasn’t accepted. Check it and try again.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.body: Their answer and their seat go with them, and the headcount stops counting them.
remove.lastInHousehold: Nobody else is in “{{household}}”, so the household is removed too.
remove.handOver: Someone else in their household will receive the invitation instead.
remove.checkedInBody: They were checked in at the door, which is the record that they came.

status.removedWithHousehold: {{name}} was removed, and so was their household.

problems.check: Some details weren’t accepted. Check them and try again.
problems.addForbidden: Your role on this event lets you see the guest list but not add to it. The event’s owner can change your role.
problems.editForbidden: Your role on this event lets you see the guest list but not change it. The event’s owner can change your role.
problems.householdForbidden: Your role on this event lets you see the guest list but not change it. The event’s owner can change your role.
problems.removeForbidden: Your role on this event lets you see the guest list but not remove guests. The event’s owner can change your role.
problems.importForbidden: Your role on this event doesn’t allow importing guests. The event’s owner can change your role.
problems.addMissing: That household is no longer on the list. The list has been reloaded.
problems.editMissing: This guest, or the household you chose, is no longer on the list. The list has been reloaded.
problems.householdMissing: This household is no longer on the list. The list has been reloaded.
problems.removeMissing: This guest is no longer on the list. The list has been reloaded.
problems.importMissing: This event is no longer available.
problems.editErased: This guest’s details can no longer be changed. They may have been erased at their request. The list has been reloaded.
problems.checkedIn: This guest was checked in at the door, which is the record that they came, so they can’t be removed. The list has been reloaded.
problems.moved: Someone moved this guest to another household just now. The list has been reloaded; try again.
problems.importRunning: An import of this list is already running. Try again when it has finished.
problems.tooLarge: This file is over 2 MB. A guest list fits well under that, so check it is the right file.
problems.tooManyRows: This file has more than 2,000 guests. Split it, and import each part.

import.title: Import guests
import.lead: Upload a CSV file of up to 2 MB and 2,000 guests. Each row is a guest, and a first name is all a row needs.
import.columns: Columns are found by their heading: first name, last name, email, phone, household, seats, side and language. Guests who share a household name are invited together.
import.excel: From Excel or Google Sheets, save the file as “CSV UTF-8 (comma delimited)”. A file saved another way may not be read.
import.again: Uploading a corrected file again updates the guests already there rather than adding them twice.

result.FAILED: Nothing was imported. {{rows}} could not be imported.
result.PROCESSING: The import has not finished yet.

import.inEnglish: The reasons are given in English for now.

history.title: Past imports
history.refused: Past imports aren’t available to your role on this event.
